Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2, 2026

This policy explains how Algarithm ("Algarithm", "we", "us") collects, uses and shares personal information when you visit our landing pages or book a call with us. If you have questions, contact us at hello@algarithm.co.uk.

Who we are

Algarithm is a marketing agency that runs paid advertising and conversion tracking for businesses. For the personal information described in this policy, we are the data controller.

Information we collect

Information you give us

When you book a call, our booking form collects your name, email address, phone number, business name and any answers you give to the form's questions.

Information collected automatically

When you visit our pages, we and our partners collect information about your device and how you use the page. This includes your IP address, browser type, the page you arrived from, the ad you clicked (through campaign parameters such as utm_campaign and Meta's fbclid), the pages you view, and actions such as clicking a button, playing a video or booking a call. Some of this is collected using cookies, pixels and similar technologies.

How we use your information

  • To schedule, confirm and hold the call you booked, including sending reminders by email and text message.
  • To follow up with you about our services after the call.
  • To measure which of our ads and pages lead to bookings, and to improve them.
  • To show our ads to people who are likely to be interested in our services, including people similar to those who have booked with us.
  • To keep records, protect our business and comply with the law.

Advertising and tracking

We use the Meta Pixel and Meta Conversions API. These send information about your visit and actions on our pages (for example, that you booked a call) to Meta Platforms, Inc. When we send contact details such as your email address or phone number to Meta, they are hashed (converted into an unreadable code) before they leave our systems. Meta uses this information to measure our ads, match visits to Meta accounts, and help deliver our ads to relevant people. Meta's use of this information is governed by the Meta Privacy Policy.

You can control the ads you see on Facebook and Instagram in your Meta ad preferences, and you can block cookies in your browser settings.

Who we share information with

We share personal information only with service providers that help us run our business, under contracts that limit how they can use it:

  • HighLevel (LeadConnector): our booking calendar and CRM, which stores your booking and contact details and sends confirmations and reminders.
  • Meta Platforms, Inc.: advertising and measurement, as described above.
  • Our website host: serves these pages and keeps standard server logs.
  • Google: loads the fonts used on these pages, and YouTube plays any video you choose to watch. YouTube videos use privacy-enhanced mode and load only when you click play.

We may also disclose information if required by law, or as part of a merger or sale of our business. We do not sell your personal information for money.

Text messages and calls

If you give us your phone number when booking, you agree that we may call or text you about your booking and our services. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies. You can reply STOP to any text message to opt out, or HELP for help. Agreeing to receive messages is not a condition of any purchase. We do not share your phone number or text messaging consent with third parties for their own marketing.

Your privacy rights

United States residents

Depending on the state you live in (including California, Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia, Texas and others), you may have the right to:

  • know what personal information we have collected about you and get a copy of it;
  • correct inaccurate information;
  • delete your information;
  • opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of your information, or its use for targeted advertising. Our use of the Meta Pixel may count as "sharing" or targeted advertising under some state laws;
  • not be treated differently for using these rights.

To use any of these rights, email hello@algarithm.co.uk. We honor Global Privacy Control signals sent by your browser as a request to opt out of sharing. We will verify your request before acting on it, and you can use an authorized agent to make a request on your behalf.

UK and European residents

If you are in the UK or the European Economic Area, we process your information on these legal bases: to take steps you've asked for before entering into a contract (booking and holding your call); our legitimate interests in running and promoting our business (follow-up and ad measurement); and your consent, where the law requires it for cookies and similar technologies. You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to our processing of your information, to data portability, and to withdraw consent at any time. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk) or your local data protection authority.

International transfers

We are based in the United Kingdom and our service providers may process information in the United States and other countries. Where we transfer information internationally, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as the UK International Data Transfer Addendum or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

How long we keep information

We keep booking and contact information for as long as we have a business relationship with you, and for up to three years after our last contact, unless the law requires us to keep it longer. Advertising partners keep information according to their own policies.

Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information, including encrypted connections and access controls. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

Children

Our services are for businesses and are not directed at anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top shows when it was last changed.

Contact us

Email hello@algarithm.co.uk with any questions or requests about your personal information.
